payload.title: Creating LiPD files from a tabular template
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook demonstrates how to programmatically create LiPD files from an Excel template using the PyLiPD library. It involves reading metadata, paleo data, and chronology data from specified sheets in the Excel file, and then organizing this information into a structured LiPD dataset. The notebook also covers handling new standard terms and adding ensemble tables to the dataset. The final output is a LiPD file that encapsulates the dataset's metadata, paleo data, and chronology data.
goals: Create a LiPD formatted Dataset from an Excel template
Save the Dataset to a file
